_instructions: Calculated via: shasum -a 256 <binary>. Update after each binary upgrade. For rustup, download the script first: curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs -o rustup-init.sh && shasum -a 256 rustup-init.sh. For brush, do NOT re-hash the archive you just downloaded — that only attests to what the server served. Upstream publishes its own digests per release: https://github.com/ArthurBrussee/brush/releases/download/<tag>/sha256.sum (and a <asset>.sha256 sidecar). darwin_brush is pinned to v0.3.0; it must be re-pinned whenever get_remote_version() starts resolving to a newer tag, otherwise the fail-closed check aborts the install. upscayl-ncnn publishes no checksum sidecar upstream, so darwin_upscayl/linux_upscayl are re-hashed from the downloaded release zip directly (tag 20251207-174704) — re-pin on every new release since get_remote_version() always tracks 'latest', unlike brush's deliberate pin.
